title: Todd Combs - Charlie Munger's Legacy
summary:
Joining us is Todd Combs, an investment officer at Berkshire
Hathaway and a close acquaintance of Munger. Todd shares personal
anecdotes and insights into Munger's profound influence on the
investment world and his unique approach to life and business. From
his early meetings with Munger to the invaluable lessons on value
investing and rational thinking, Todd provides an intimate look
into the wisdom of one of the greatest investors of our time.
